comparison.objective: Identify opaque empty bottles by lifting and place only those bottles in recycling.
comparison.physical_skill: Weight discrimination followed by pick-and-place while preserving bottle orientation.
comparison.success_condition: Both empty bottles upright in the bin; any full bottle in the bin, tipped bottle, or lost bottle fails.
comparison.reason: This is hidden-property classification and sorting, with no adjustment interface, force-limited locking, or dynamic response optimization.
